caption:
Meta whistleblower urges Andy Burnham to go further on NDA ban

Sarah Wynn-Williams warns that tech insiders with concerns about AI development need to be protected. Wynn-Williams served as director of global public policy at Meta, then called Facebook. She made allegations about the social media company's treatment of teenagers. She says tech insiders with concerns about AI are being silenced in a system reminiscent of George Orwell's 1984.

Reported by The Guardian.
